mapper.select: WITH Ranked AS ( SELECT ol.ProductId AS ProductId, ol.LineNumber AS LineNumber, ol.Quantity AS Quantity, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ol.ProductId ORDER BY ol.Quantity DESC, ol.LineNumber ASC) AS RowNumber FROM {{schema}}.ShopOrderLines AS ol) SELECT r.ProductId AS ProductId, r.LineNumber AS LineNumber, r.Quantity AS Quantity FROM Ranked AS r WHERE r.RowNumber = 1
